categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in intelligent recognition and analysis technologies, providing information technology solutions including software and hardware. Its main business segments include digital conference systems, tobacco industry information solutions, banknote inspection, oil and gas digital production management, government information systems, and smart healthcare. These segments serve various industries such as government, tobacco, printing, oil and gas, and healthcare.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include high-speed machine vision and intelligent analysis based on artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms. The company develops integrated hardware and software systems for real-time quality inspection in continuous manufacturing industries. It also focuses on AI-driven big data, cloud computing, edge computing, and multi-modal large models, with proprietary platforms for machine vision applications and low-code development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are government agencies, tobacco enterprises, central banks and financial institutions, oil and gas companies, healthcare institutions, and large industrial manufacturers. The company serves national-level and provincial government bodies, state-owned enterprises, and specialized industries requiring digital transformation and intelligent automation solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters in Chengdu and multiple branches across major Chinese regions including Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, and others. It also exports products to over ten countries, including South Korea, Indonesia, Russia, UAE, and Taiwan, expanding its international presence particularly in tobacco physical inspection products.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the information technology and industrial automation supply chain. It provides integrated software and hardware solutions, system integration, and technical services, acting as a solution provider and technology developer rather than a raw material supplier or pure hardware manufacturer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing AI technologies such as machine vision large models, multi-modal data fusion, and edge-cloud computing platforms. The company emphasizes innovation in intelligent manufacturing, smart governance, digital healthcare, and industrial internet platforms. It invests heavily in R&D to develop proprietary AI algorithms, low-code platforms, and industry-specific intelligent solutions, aiming to enhance competitiveness and expand product lines.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of integrated information technology solutions, including software and hardware products, as well as customized technical development and ongoing technical services. The company secures contracts primarily via public tenders and direct negotiations, delivering project-based solutions and maintenance services to institutional clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in high-speed machine vision and intelligent analysis, holding a dominant position in digital conference systems and banknote inspection markets. It ranks among the top three suppliers in tobacco industry information solutions and is a key partner for major oil and gas companies. Its strong brand, technological innovation, and government backing provide competitive advantages over peers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately 507 million RMB, a 14.27% decrease from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about 9.58 million RMB, down 75.10%. Despite short-term declines due to market and policy factors, the company maintains stable asset-liability structure and continues to invest heavily in R&D (up 18.85%). It achieved a new contract signing growth of 4%, indicating ongoing business expansion potential.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its unique combination of 'industry experts + technology experts' to deliver tailored, high-precision AI-driven solutions that integrate software and hardware. Its proprietary high-speed machine vision technology enables real-time quality inspection in complex manufacturing processes, enhancing automation and efficiency. The company’s strong brand reputation, long-term government and institutional client relationships, and comprehensive product-service integration differentiate it in the market.
